help:
HarranCraft binary inspector

Usage: hc-inspect [--language en-US|zh-CN] [--json] [--exports] FILE ...

Read metadata and SHA-256 from 1–16 explicit AMD64 PE32+ files.
--json       Write a versioned JSON inspection report.
--exports    Include named, ordinal-only and forwarded exports.
--language   Select output language; unsupported values fall back to en-US.
--version    Print the tool version.
--help, -h   Show this help.

Maximum file size: 512 MiB. No game files are loaded or changed.
A successful inspection is not a game compatibility result.
error.arguments: Provide 1–16 file arguments with supported options. Run hc-inspect --help.
error.invalid_pe: The file has an invalid or unsupported PE header or section layout.
error.unsupported_machine: The file is not an AMD64 executable image.
error.unsupported_format: The file is not in PE32+ format.
error.unbacked_rva: Requested metadata is not fully backed by file bytes.
error.invalid_exports: The export table contains invalid names, indices or addresses.
error.invalid_resources: The version resource has an invalid structure.
error.metadata_limit: Metadata exceeds the bounded inspection limits.
error.file_limit: The file exceeds the 512 MiB inspection limit.
error.input_changed: The input changed during inspection. Retry with an unchanged file.
error.not_regular_file: The input is not a regular file.
error.input_unreadable: The input could not be read. Check the file and read permission.
